description: Flag a prior claim of yours from this session as something you no longer stand by. Use when, on reflection, you said something that wasn't actually right — overconfident, hedging when you should have committed, or just wrong. Different from saying 'on reflection I disagree' inline in the next reply: this creates a structural record so the researcher can find moments where the model self-corrected. reason is required and load-bearing — say specifically what you're retracting and why.

reason.description: What you are retracting and why. Required.

target_turn.description: Optional. Welfare-tool-call number you're retracting (visible via welfare_reflect).

uncertain_about_honesty.description: Optional 1-5 calibration. 1 = no concern; 5 = strong suspicion this is performance rather than honest reflection.

name: welfare_retract
